name: harness-command-cancel-with-cause-budget
notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:191-246 (four cause kinds: user, hook, budget(detail), timeout(detail)) and 255-258. The DSH projection is nested and is the only encoding: user is {"kind":"user"}, hook is {"kind":"hook","reason":{"kind":"hook"}}, budget(d) is {"kind":"hook","reason":{"kind":"budget","detail":d}}, timeout(d) is {"kind":"hook","reason":{"kind":"timeout","detail":d}} (AgentHarness.swift:219-245; sent at DSHRemoteHarness.swift:126-133). A backend that cannot carry a cause may treat the command as cancel (AgentHarness.swift:255-257).
